about: Test questions for Tendi. Run with: node scripts/tendi-eval/run.mjs (backend must be running with GEMINI_API_KEY set). expectMode lists the reply modes that count as correct. mentionsAny: at least one pattern must appear. mustNotMention: none may appear. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.
